title: Slow English Podcast #346: 20 Easy Facts About Albania

sentences.text: Hello, everyone. My name is Amili. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. I am very happy you are here today.
Today we will learn about a beautiful country in Europe. The country is Albania.
I will speak slowly and use easy English. Let's begin. Fact 1. Albania is in Europe.
Albania is a country in Southeast Europe. It is part of the Balkan Peninsula.
The country has beautiful mountains, rivers and beaches.
Many people visit Albania every year. It is becoming a popular travel destination.
Fact 2. The capital city is Tarana. Tarana is the capital and the largest city in Albania.
It is colorful and modern. Many people live and work there.
The city has parks, museums, restaurants and cafes. Tarana is the center of culture and business in the country.
Fact 3. Albania has beautiful beaches. Albania has a long coastline. The country is next to the Adriatic Sea and the Ionian Sea.
The water is clear and blue. Many people swim, relax and enjoy the sunshine.
The beaches are very popular in summer. Fact 4. Albania has many mountains.
Much of the country is covered by mountains and hills. The Albanian Alps are very beautiful.
People enjoy hiking and camping there. The mountains are green in summer and snowy in winter.
Nature is one of Albania's greatest treasures. Fact 5. The official language is Albanian.
People in Albanian speak Albanian. It is one of the oldest languages in Europe.
Children learn Albanian at school. Many people also speak English, Italian or Greek.
Visitors can often communicate easily. Fact 6. Albania has a long history.
People have lived in Albania for thousands of years. Many ancient civilizations lived there.
The country has old castles, churches, mosques and historical towns.
History is an important part of Albanian culture.
Visitors enjoy exploring these places.
Fact 7. The Albanian flag is easy to recognize. The flag is red.
It has a black double-headed eagle in the middle. It is one of the most famous flags in Europe.
Albanians are very proud of their national flag.
Fact 8. Family is very important. Families often spend a lot of time together.
People respect their parents and grandparents.
Family meals are special. Many celebrations include the whole family.
Helping each other is an important value.
Fact 9. Albanian food is delicious. Many meals include meat, vegetables, cheese and fresh bread.
People also enjoy grilled food. One popular food is birec.
Birec is made with thin pastry and different fillings like cheese, meat or spinach.
Many people also enjoy fresh yogurt.
Fact 10. Coffee is very popular. People love drinking coffee.
There are many cafes in every city.
Friends often meet for coffee and conversation.
Coffee culture is an important part of daily life.
People enjoy relaxing together.
Fact 11. Albania has many rivers and lakes.
The country has beautiful rivers. It also has large lakes.
Lake Orid is one of the oldest lakes in the world.
Nature lovers enjoy visiting these places. The views are peaceful and beautiful.
Fact 12. There are many castles. Albania has many old castles.
One famous castle is in the city of birec.
Another famous castle is in crew.
These castles tell the story of Albania's history.
Visitors enjoy walking through them.
Fact 13. Birec is called the city of a thousand windows.
Birec is one of the most beautiful cities in Albania.
Its white houses stand on the hillside.
The many windows give the city its famous nickname.
It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Many tourists visit every year.
Fact 14. Albania has four seasons.
Spring is green and colorful.
Summer is warm and sunny.
Autumn is cool and beautiful.
Winter brings snow to the mountains.
Every season has something special.
Fact 15. Albanians are known for hospitality.
Guests are very important.
People welcome visitors warmly.
They often offer food, coffee or tea.
Kindness and respect are important traditions.
Many visitors remember Albanian hospitality.
Fact 16. Music and dancing are important.
Traditional Albanian music is very special.
People sing and dance during weddings and festivals.
Traditional clothes are colorful.
Celebrations are full of happiness and music.
Fact 17. Football is the most popular sport.
Many children play football after school.
Families watch football matches together.
People proudly support the Albanian national team.
Sports bring people together.
Fact 8. Albania has many beautiful national parks.
The country protects its forests, mountains and rivers.
Visitors enjoy hiking and taking photos.
Many different animals live in these parks.
Nature is clean and peaceful.
Fact 19. Tourism is growing every year.
More people are discovering Albania.
Visitors enjoy the beaches, mountains, history and friendly people.
Many travelers say Albania is one of Europe's hidden gems.
It offers beautiful places at affordable prices.
Fact 20. Albania is a wonderful country to explore.
It has beautiful beaches, high mountains, old castles,
delicious food and friendly people.
The country has a rich history and a bright future.
Many visitors leave with happy memories.
Albania is a small country with a big heart.
I hope you learned something new today.
Keep listening, keep practicing and keep enjoying English.
